hero.title: Turn idle AI APIs into
hero.subtitle: BloomX lets merchants list tested model APIs, while users subscribe with credits and call the right merchant model at the right price.

features.title: Why BloomX
features.subtitle: A unified marketplace for model API supply, subscriptions, calls, and settlement.

routing.title: Pre-listing API tests
routing.description: Merchants submit model name, Base URL, and API key. BloomX tests the API before it can be listed.

credits.title: Unified credits
credits.description: Users buy credits or subscribe to packages, then spend by model, merchant, and price.

verified.title: Merchant settlement
verified.description: Merchants track calls, success rate, and revenue, then settle monthly or withdraw manually.

compatible.title: OpenAI-compatible
compatible.description: BloomX prioritizes mainstream OpenAI-compatible APIs to reduce integration cost.

howItWorks.title: How to use BloomX
howItWorks.subtitle: Merchant supply, user subscription, and platform settlement in one clear loop.

step1.title: Merchants submit APIs
step1.description: Add model name, URL, key, price, and description. BloomX runs a real connection test first.

step2.title: Users subscribe
step2.description: Users choose merchant, model, price, and package before they call.

step3.title: Calls settle automatically
step3.description: Successful calls deduct credits and count as merchant revenue. Failed calls refund users.

pricing.title: Simple credit packages
pricing.subtitle: Buy credits first, spend per merchant model, and get automatic refunds on failed calls.

checkout.signInRequired: Please sign in before buying a credit package.

starter.name: Starter
starter.desc: For personal tests and small workloads

pro.name: Pro
pro.desc: For stable production traffic and frequent calls

models.title: Mainstream model supply.
models.subtitle: Representative model directions BloomX can route. Actual sellable models come from listings that pass merchant API tests.

testimonials.title: Built for real supply and demand.
testimonials.quote1: Merchants can turn idle API capacity into settlement revenue instead of leaving it unused.
testimonials.quote2: Users do not need to hunt for keys. They subscribe to tested merchant models and call through BloomX.
testimonials.quote3: Failed calls keep records and refund credits, which makes this a sustainable marketplace rather than a simple reseller.

cta.title: Build the marketplace for model API capacity
cta.subtitle: First close the loop: registration, email verification, merchant API tests, subscriptions, and calls. Then connect real payment and payout.
